Ideally positioned close to the beach, this well presented property offers relaxed no fuss coastal living in a sought after and well maintained complex. It has attractive sea views and a lovely outlook across a landscaped communal garden and swimming pool, all in a peaceful yet very convenient setting close to the beach and local amenities.

The home features a covered patio and outdoor braai area ideal for entertaining or relaxing family afternoons. The unit offers a very spacious and practical layout. This includes a modern and well appointed open plan kitchen leading seamlessly into the dining room and comfortable lounge area with direct access outside to the patio/braai area. Upstairs are 3 large comfortable bedrooms with plenty of in built storage. The master is generously sized with an attached patio with views of the sea and gardens and features a modern and spacious en suite. A further large bathroom with separate shower area and a spacious upper landing ensure the living spaces are generous. An attached garage adds extra convenience and space.

This property is a ideal opportunity to own a perfectly situated holiday home with excellent income investment potential
